content: Two new individually authored families each pair a movement decision with a shot decision. Their changed-context return points reverse the invitation: an early arrival still meets a low ball; an early recovery still meets a deeper return. The original four-decision point remains intact.
modelledAdaptations: Player preparation timing or recovery position, retaining original strike and contact poses
Make Room option B: a ballistic deep-middle reset from the original contact, with a single modelled bounce; no opponent reply
reviewFinding: A proposed crosscourt label contradicted a down-the-line trajectory. The option was replaced with an explicitly modelled deep-middle reset and a source test for direction, depth and clearance. The original scenes remain unchanged.

coachingSource.author: LTA expert coach Matt Smith
coachingSource.application: Early movement, adjustment steps and recovery. Tactical applications and drills are GameSharp-authored; no endorsement is implied.

requestedYoutubeSources: The two previously shared channel pages were throttled in this review. No claim is made that their videos were watched or used as direct evidence for these new plays.

voice.behaviour: Two short sentences selected by both committed decisions, including valid alternatives. Existing default-on and saved opt-out behaviour retained. Final replay precedes speech; comparison and replay cannot retrigger automatic speech.

returnLoop: Three originals progress without silent repetition. Each paired return becomes due the next local calendar day; beta users can open it earlier as explicitly labelled practice. Unfinished originals and due returns remain reachable. Every point remains in Explore. Next Live Point is the primary continuation when available.
measurement: Retain original attempts and two learning signals, distinguish first unexposed later-day attempts from practice, and record reached comparison evidence. Browser-local progress does not identify cross-device users or establish on-court transfer.

productionEffort.limitation: Authoring, animation adaptation and self-review were interleaved and timed as an elapsed envelope. No separate professional coaching review was performed; this is not a measured sustainable weekly production rate.
productionEffort.nextDecision: Review actual first returns, changed-context choices and qualitative beta feedback before commissioning more families. Reusing source assets reduces animation work but does not remove per-play editorial review.

verification: Every authored route on mobile, reduced-motion tablet and desktop
Recorded cue mappings and real Web Audio playback
Exact Git Preview and staged Production equivalence before promotion
unverified: Measured retention or on-court learning transfer
